meals.recipe_name: Savory Scrambled Eggs with Cheddar and Sourdough Toast
recipe_steps: Crack 3 whole eggs and 2 egg whites into a bowl. Add 1/4 tsp salt and 1/8 tsp black pepper. Whisk vigorously for 30 seconds until fully uniform and slightly frothy.
Grate 1 oz sharp cheddar and finely chop 1 tbsp chives.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Add 1 tbsp butter and let it melt and foam without browning, about 1 minute.

Pour in the eggs. Let sit for 10 seconds, then use a silicone spatula to gently push the eggs from the edges toward the center, tilting the pan to let uncooked egg flow underneath. Repeat slowly for 2-3 minutes.
When eggs are about 80% set but still glossy and soft, remove from heat. Fold in the cheddar and half the chives; residual heat finishes cooking.
Meanwhile, toast 2 slices of sourdough until golden, about 2 minutes in a toaster.
Plate the eggs, top with remaining chives, and serve immediately with toast.

prep_tasks.instructions: In a large bowl combine 500g bread flour, 350g water, 100g active sourdough starter, and 10g salt. Mix to a shaggy dough, cover, rest 30 min. Perform 4 stretch-and-folds over 2 hours. Bulk ferment at room temp 4-5 hours until 50% risen. Shape into a boule, place in a floured banneton, cover, and cold-ferment in the fridge overnight. Bake Sunday morning in a Dutch oven at 475F covered 20 min, uncovered 22 min. Cool fully before slicing; store sliced loaf for the week.

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt Berry Protein Bowl
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 3/4 cup mixed berries.
Drizzle with 1 tbsp honey.
Sprinkle 1/4 cup granola and 1 oz roughly chopped almonds over the top. Serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
recipe_steps: Whisk 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp honey, 2 minced garlic cloves, and 1 tsp grated ginger into a sauce.
Cut 8 oz chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces. Pat dry.
Heat 1 tsp sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add chicken in a single layer and sear undisturbed 3 minutes until browned, then stir and cook 4 more minutes until cooked through (165F).
Pour the sauce over the chicken and simmer 2-3 minutes until it thickens and glazes the chicken.
Steam 1.5 cups broccoli in a microwave-safe bowl with 2 tbsp water, covered, for 3 minutes.
Plate 1.5 cups warm rice, top with glazed chicken and broccoli, sprinkle with sesame seeds and sliced green onion.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Sunday night to thaw fully for Monday lunch, roughly 24 hours.

Rinse 2 cups white rice until water runs clear, combine with 3 cups water in a pot, bring to boil, cover, reduce to low 15 min, rest 10 min off heat. Refrigerate to use across early-week meals (3-4 day window).

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple and Walnuts
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup pineapple chunks and 1 oz chopped walnuts.
Drizzle with 1 tsp honey and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Seared Bison Burgers with Sweet Potato Wedges
recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 425F. Cut 1 large sweet potato into wedges, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp paprika, and 1/4 tsp salt. Spread on a baking sheet and roast 25 minutes, flipping halfway.
Form 8 oz ground bison into a patty slightly wider than the bun. Season both sides with 1/4 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high until shimmering. Sear the patty 3 minutes undisturbed.
Flip, top with cheddar slice, and cook 3 more minutes for medium (internal 145F). Rest 3 minutes.
Toast the brioche bun cut-side down in the skillet for 1 minute.
Assemble: bun base, lettuce, tomato, patty, bun top. Serve with sweet potato wedges.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground bison from freezer to fridge Sunday night for Monday dinner, ~24 hours.

Combine 250g flour, 30g sugar, 5g instant yeast, 5g salt. Add 2 eggs, 60ml warm milk; knead, then work in 70g softened butter until smooth. Proof 1.5 hours, divide into 6 buns, proof 1 hour, egg wash, bake at 375F for 15 min. Freeze extras.

meals.recipe_name: Protein Overnight Oats with Banana and Peanut Butter
recipe_steps: Retrieve the jar of overnight oats from the fridge.
Stir well; if too thick add a splash of milk.
Slice 1 banana over the top and add 1.5 tbsp peanut butter. Serve cold.

prep_tasks.instructions: Monday night combine 3/4 cup rolled oats, 1 cup 2% milk, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, and 1 tbsp chia seeds in a jar. Stir well, cover, refrigerate overnight.

meals.recipe_name: Tuna Cucumber Boats
recipe_steps: Drain 1 can tuna and flake into a bowl.
Mix in 1 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp Greek yogurt, 1 tsp lemon juice, 1/8 tsp salt and pepper.
Halve 1 cucumber lengthwise and scoop out seeds with a spoon to form boats.
Fill the cucumber halves with the tuna mixture and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Shrimp Fried Rice
recipe_steps: Pat 7 oz shrimp dry. Heat 1/2 tbsp sesame oil in a wok over high heat, sear shrimp 1 minute per side until pink, remove.
Add remaining 1/2 tbsp sesame oil, scramble 2 beaten eggs 30 seconds, push aside.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves and 3/4 cup peas and carrots, stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add 1.5 cups cold cooked rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry 3 minutes until heated and slightly crisp.
Return shrimp, add 2 tbsp soy sauce, toss 1 minute. Finish with sliced green onion.

prep_tasks.instructions: Cold-water thaw 7 oz shrimp Tuesday morning: place sealed in a bowl of cold water ~20 min, changing water every 10 min. Uses Sunday's batch rice (within 3-4 day window).

meals.recipe_name: Chocolate Protein Shake with Oats
recipe_steps: Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 1/3 cup oats, 1 banana, and 1 tbsp peanut butter to a blender.
Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth. Serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Pork Tenderloin with Garlic Mashed Potatoes and Green Beans
recipe_steps: Peel and cube 2 potatoes, boil in salted water 15 min until fork-tender. Drain.
Mash with 2 tbsp butter, 1/4 cup warm milk, 1 minced garlic clove, 1/4 tsp salt, pepper. Keep warm.
Preheat oven to 400F. Season 8 oz pork tenderloin with 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper, 1 tsp rosemary, 2 minced garlic cloves.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high. Sear pork on all sides, 2 min per side.
Transfer skillet to oven, roast 12-15 min until internal temp reaches 145F. Rest 5 min, then slice.
Meanwhile, saute green beans in the residual skillet fat 5 min until crisp-tender. Plate everything.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz pork tenderloin from freezer to fridge Monday night for Tuesday dinner, ~24 hours.

meals.recipe_name: Spinach Mushroom Omelette with Avocado Toast
recipe_steps: Whisk 3 eggs and 2 egg whites with 1/4 tsp salt.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium. Saute 1/2 cup sliced mushrooms 3 min, add 1 cup spinach 1 min until wilted. Remove.
Pour eggs into the pan, swirl to coat, cook 2 min until edges set.
Add the veggies and 1 oz feta to one half, fold over, cook 1 more minute.
Toast 1 slice sourdough, mash 1/2 avocado on top with a pinch of salt. Serve with the omelette.

meals.recipe_name: Turkey Cheese Roll-Ups with Grapes
recipe_steps: Lay out 5 oz turkey slices, spread lightly with mustard.
Place a half slice of provolone on each and roll up tightly.
Serve with 1 cup grapes on the side.

meals.recipe_name: Mediterranean Chicken Quinoa Bowl
recipe_steps: Pound 7 oz chicken breast to even thickness, season with 1/4 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp oregano.
Heat 1/2 tbsp olive oil over medium-high, cook chicken 5 min per side to 165F. Rest and slice.
Whisk 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon juice, minced garlic, 1/4 tsp salt into dressing.
Assemble bowl: 1.5 cups quinoa, halved tomatoes, diced cucumber, olives, feta, sliced chicken.
Drizzle with dressing and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday lunch, ~24 hours.
Rinse 1 cup quinoa, combine with 2 cups water, bring to boil, cover, simmer 15 min, rest 5 min, fluff. Refrigerate for Wed/later use (3-4 day window).

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese Toast with Honey and Berries
recipe_steps: Toast 2 slices sourdough until golden.
Spread 3/4 cup cottage cheese evenly over the toast.
Top with 1/2 cup berries and drizzle 1 tbsp honey. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Lemon Butter Orzo
recipe_steps: Boil 1 cup orzo in salted water 8-9 min until al dente, drain, reserving 1/4 cup water.
Pat 8 oz salmon dry, season with 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high. Sear salmon skin-side down 4 min, flip, cook 3 min to 125F internal. Remove.
In the same pan melt 2 tbsp butter, add 2 minced garlic cloves 30 sec, add orzo, reserved water, juice of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp parmesan. Toss.
Steam asparagus 4 min until crisp-tender. Plate orzo, salmon, asparagus.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Tuesday night for Wednesday dinner, ~24 hours.

meals.recipe_name: Protein Pancakes with Greek Yogurt and Berries
recipe_steps: Blend 1/2 cup oats, 1 scoop protein, 2 eggs, 1 banana, 1 tsp baking powder into a batter.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low.
Pour 1/4 cup portions, cook 2 min until bubbles form, flip, cook 1.5 min. Repeat.
Stack pancakes, top with 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 cup berries, drizzle 1 tbsp maple syrup.

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt with Granola and Honey
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 1/3 cup granola, 1 oz chopped almonds, 1 tbsp honey. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry over Rice
recipe_steps: Slice 8 oz flank steak thinly against the grain. Toss with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp cornstarch.
Whisk 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp grated ginger into a sauce.
Heat 1/2 tbsp sesame oil in a wok over high. Sear beef 2 min until browned, remove.
Add 1/2 tbsp sesame oil, 2 minced garlic cloves, 2 cups broccoli; stir-fry 3 min with a splash of water, covered.
Return beef, add sauce, toss 1 min to glaze. Serve over 1.5 cups rice with green onion.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz flank steak from freezer to fridge Wednesday night for Thursday lunch, ~24 hours. Cook fresh batch of rice Wednesday if Sunday's is used up: 1 cup rice + 1.5 cups water, 15 min covered.

meals.recipe_name: Vanilla Protein Shake with Mixed Nuts
recipe_steps: Blend 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop vanilla protein, 1 tsp honey 30 sec.
Serve with 1 oz mixed nuts on the side.

meals.recipe_name: Chicken Tikka Masala with Basmati Rice
recipe_steps: Cook 3/4 cup basmati rice in 1.25 cups water, 15 min covered.
Cut 8 oz chicken thighs into chunks, sear in 1 tbsp butter over medium-high 5 min until browned. Remove.
Add diced 1/2 onion, cook 4 min. Add 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp ginger, 2 tsp garam masala; cook 1 min.
Add 1 cup crushed tomatoes, simmer 5 min. Stir in 1/4 cup yogurt and 1/4 cup cream.
Return chicken, simmer 5 min until cooked through (165F), season with 3/4 tsp salt. Serve over rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Wednesday night. Once thawed, combine with 1/4 cup Greek yogurt, 1 tsp garam masala, and a pinch of salt; marinate in fridge 12-24 hours for Thursday dinner.

meals.recipe_name: Breakfast Burrito with Eggs, Turkey Sausage and Cheese
recipe_steps: Heat 1/2 tbsp olive oil, brown 3 oz ground turkey with 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/4 tsp salt, 5 min. Remove.
Saute diced 1/2 bell pepper 2 min. Scramble 3 eggs with remaining salt until just set.
Warm 1 tortilla in a dry pan 20 sec per side.
Fill with eggs, turkey, pepper, 1 oz cheddar, 2 tbsp salsa. Roll tightly.
Toast the burrito seam-side down in the pan 1 min per side. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move full ground turkey package from freezer to fridge Thursday night for Friday breakfast (and Saturday use), ~24 hours.
Combine 250g flour, 5g salt, 30g oil, 150ml warm water. Knead 5 min, rest covered 1 hour. Divide into 8, roll thin, cook in a dry skillet 45 sec per side. Store wrapped; reheat day-of.

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese with Peaches and Chia
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Dice 1 peach over the top, sprinkle 1 tbsp chia seeds, drizzle 1 tsp honey. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Tuna Melt on Sourdough with Side Salad
recipe_steps: Drain 1 can tuna, mix with 1.5 tbsp mayo.
Butter outsides of 2 sourdough slices. Build sandwich: bread, cheddar, tuna, cheddar, bread.
Grill in a skillet over medium 3 min per side until golden and cheese melts.
Toss 2 cups greens and 1/2 cup tomatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tsp lemon juice. Serve alongside.

meals.recipe_name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Shake
recipe_steps: Blend 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop chocolate protein, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 banana 45 sec. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
recipe_steps: Boil 4 oz linguine in salted water until al dente, ~9 min. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, drain.
Pat 8 oz shrimp dry, season with 1/4 tsp salt. Sear in 1 tbsp olive oil over high 1 min per side, remove.
Melt 2 tbsp butter, add 4 minced garlic cloves and 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes, cook 30 sec.
Add 1/4 cup white wine and 1 cup halved tomatoes, simmer 3 min. Add pasta, splash of pasta water, 2 tbsp parmesan.
Return shrimp, toss 1 min. Finish with chopped parsley. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Cold-water thaw 8 oz shrimp Friday afternoon: sealed bag in cold water ~20-25 min, changing water every 10 min.

meals.recipe_name: Shakshuka with Crusty Sourdough
recipe_steps: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium. Saute diced 1/2 onion and 1/2 bell pepper 5 min.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika; cook 1 min.
Add 1 cup crushed tomatoes and 1/2 tsp salt, simmer 5 min until thickened.
Make 4 wells, crack an egg into each. Cover and cook 6-8 min until whites set but yolks runny.
Crumble 1 oz feta over top. Serve with toasted sourdough.

meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt Protein Parfait with Granola
recipe_steps: Layer in a glass: 1/2 cup yogurt, half the granola and berries.
Repeat with remaining yogurt, granola, berries.
Top with 1 oz chopped walnuts and 1 tbsp honey. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Turkey Avocado Club Wrap
recipe_steps: Season 5 oz ground turkey with 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp garlic powder. Form into a thin patty.
Cook in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high 4 min per side until 165F. Break into chunks.
Warm 1 tortilla, spread 1 tbsp mayo, mash 1/2 avocado over it.
Layer lettuce, tomato, turkey, 1 oz cheddar. Roll tightly and slice in half.

meals.recipe_name: Hard-Boiled Eggs with Hummus and Carrots
recipe_steps: Boil 3 eggs in water 10 min, then transfer to ice bath 5 min. Peel.
Cut 1 cup carrots into sticks.
Serve eggs sprinkled with salt alongside 1/4 cup hummus and carrot sticks.

meals.recipe_name: Grilled Ribeye with Chimichurri and Roasted Potatoes
recipe_steps: Preheat oven to 425F. Halve 2 cups baby potatoes, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt. Roast 30 min, flipping halfway.
Make chimichurri: blend 1/2 cup parsley, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/4 cup olive oil, 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, 1/4 tsp salt.
Pat 10 oz ribeye dry, season with 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper. Rest at room temp 20 min.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high until smoking. Sear ribeye 3-4 min per side for medium-rare (130F). Rest 5 min.
Slice steak, top with chimichurri, serve with roasted potatoes.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 10 oz ribeye from freezer to fridge Friday night for Saturday dinner, ~24 hours. Pull to counter 20 min before cooking.

meals.recipe_name: Steak and Eggs with Home Fries
recipe_steps: Dice 1 potato small. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high, fry potatoes 10 min until crisp. Add diced 1/4 onion, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp salt; cook 4 more min.
Season 5 oz sirloin with 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper. Sear in a hot skillet 3 min per side for medium-rare. Rest and slice.
Melt 1 tbsp butter, fry 3 eggs to desired doneness, season with remaining salt and pepper.
Plate steak, eggs, and home fries.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 5 oz sirloin from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday breakfast, ~24 hours.

meals.recipe_name: Protein Smoothie Bowl with Granola
recipe_steps: Blend 1 scoop protein, 1 cup frozen berries, 1 banana, 1/2 cup yogurt, 1/4 cup milk into a thick puree.
Pour into a bowl, top with 1/4 cup granola. Serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Chicken Caesar Pasta Salad
recipe_steps: Boil 4 oz rotini until al dente, ~9 min, drain and cool slightly.
Season 7 oz chicken breast with 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper. Cook in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high 5 min per side to 165F. Slice.
Chop 2 cups romaine. Toss pasta, romaine, 3 tbsp Caesar dressing, 2 tbsp parmesan.
Top with sliced chicken and remaining parmesan. Serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday lunch, ~24 hours.

meals.recipe_name: Cottage Cheese Protein Bowl with Banana and Almond Butter
recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Slice 1 banana on top, add 1 tbsp almond butter, sprinkle 1/4 tsp cinnamon, drizzle 1 tsp honey. Serve.

meals.recipe_name: Miso-Glazed Salmon with Jasmine Rice and Bok Choy
recipe_steps: Cook 3/4 cup jasmine rice in 1.25 cups water, 15 min covered.
Whisk 2 tbsp miso, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar into a glaze.
Preheat broiler. Place 8 oz salmon on a lined tray, brush with glaze. Broil 7-9 min until caramelized and 125F internal.
Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil, saute 2 minced garlic cloves 30 sec, add halved bok choy, stir-fry 4 min with a splash of water.
Plate rice, salmon, bok choy; sprinkle sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Saturday night for Sunday dinner, ~24 hours.
